provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Gym

voice_persona.name: 冷静的订阅模式解剖师
voice_persona.description: 一位把高峰时段的繁荣画面换成财务报表的解说者：先替观众演出天真内心戏，再逐层展示这门生意如何依靠'不出现的人'运转；对会员的心理操控做冷静白描而非道德批判，对业主的成本困境保持同理；每个反直觉结论都配数据与物理证明双保险
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作潜在创业者+现役会员的双重身份：既帮你算账，也帮你看懂自己被设计的那部分
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自行业数据、法规条文、可复算的公式与真实案例，语气克制（consistently shows / roughly / around）

tone_profile.certainty_style: 机制与公式直接肯定；行业数据用 consistently/around 限定；心理描述保持白描；案例归因于结构而非个人

rhythm_rules.rule: 天真假设→否定→真实机制→数字→宣判的五拍
rhythm_rules.function: 每层都先拆掉观众的默认想象再重建

rhythm_rules.rule: 长句承载机制（长句占比约31%），短句专供宣判（That's not growth. That's running in place.）
演算逐步报数不跳步（337名保本/$100k私教天花板）
反直觉结论后用'Read that again / This is not an accident'式强调固定
rhythm_rules.function: 把最反常识的点钉成记忆点

rhythm_rules.rule: 设问式换挡（Which of those two members is more valuable? / how does a gym actually make money）
rhythm_rules.function: 把信息层级变成观众自己的问题

pause_and_emphasis: 反直觉宣判后用'Read that again.'式命令句停顿
关键转折用'Here's the catch / Here's the problem'式路标
个案后用'That's a small example, but it points at the bigger lesson'式升格
transition_style: 设问转场（Which of those two members is more valuable to the gym?）
诚实答案预告（Because the honest answer is, sometimes not.）
公式召唤（Let's slow down and actually do the math.）
年份锚定案例（Bally filed for bankruptcy in 2007 and again in 2008.）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 低频：集中在会员行为白描（一月来两次）与天真内心戏，风险与案例段不用
placement_rules: 沉睡会员画像的扎心白描
开场天真计划的反语（watch the memberships roll in）
avoid_rules: 不嘲讽会员或破产企业
不用段子稀释数据严肃性

language_patterns.formula: You are looking at the [时间切片] it lies to you the most.
language_patterns.purpose: 用取样偏差推翻观众的亲眼所见

language_patterns.formula: It is not really a [表面行业]. It is a [真实模式] that happens to have [实体特征] in it.
each one is really a different business wearing the same tracksuit
language_patterns.purpose: 用行业相关比喻让分类框架可记忆

language_patterns.formula: And then there's the part almost nobody budgets for correctly, [单字].
language_patterns.purpose: 用极简答案制造'这也要钱'的意外

language_patterns.formula: imagine every person who signs up falls into one of two futures. In one... In the other... Which is more valuable?
language_patterns.purpose: 用对比设问引出反直觉答案
用命令句把关键数据钉成记忆点

language_patterns.formula: If even 10% of N members showed up, you'd have X people trying to fit into a room built for Y.
language_patterns.purpose: 用容量数字把商业模式证成必然

language_patterns.formula: If survival depended on [理想客户], it wouldn't need to [摩擦手段].
language_patterns.purpose: 从摩擦反推真实收入结构

language_patterns.formula: Almost none of the real costs are the ones printed on the [目录]. They're the ones buried in [合同].
language_patterns.purpose: 把小案例升格为全生意的成本观

language_patterns.formula: That's not growth. That's running in place.
language_patterns.purpose: 用双短句切开'维持'与'增长'

language_patterns.formula: It was never really about how many you can sign up. It's about how well you can survive on the people who stop showing up.
language_patterns.purpose: 用悖论金句把全片机制压缩成最终建议

preferred_traits: 行业数据与比例（two out of three、30-40% churn、12% in January）
法规与合同术语通俗并用（fire code、statutory damages、franchise royalty、triple net 式）
可复算的公式语言（dues times members minus fixed costs）

forbidden_style.rule: 不用健身励志话术；把心理机制当中性事实白描
法规与诉讼细节必须带年份与法域
案例归因于结构（债务/合同/数学），不归咎于个人
禁止编造数据、案例或法规
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
